Name: PPJA - More Recipes_A Collection of Recipes
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[b][size=6]PPJA is deprecated and no longer maintained.[/size][/b]
Consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508/]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290/]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url], a continuation by some of the original PPJA artists.


-----------------------------------


[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/cLg9TOM.png[/img]﻿

[size=6][color=#f1c232]THIS MOD HAS MANY DEPENDENCIES
[/color][/size][size=2]It is not a standalone mod. Please make sure you have installed everything required [b]correctly [/b]before reporting bug issues.[/size]

Have you ever found yourself wondering "I wish I could cook more in Stardew Valley"? Well wonder no longer! [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/]Mizu's Custom Recipe Sprites[/url] are now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿!

Special thanks to Minerva for editing the edibility values!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png[/img]﻿

- Not all recipes will appear at once, some have: season, day, friendship, weather, and year requirements

If you would like to contribute to the project, we welcome pull requests on our [url=https://github.com/paradigmnomad/PPJA]Github repo[/url]﻿!  You may also submit ideas or translations there.

Tired of all of the recipes being shoved into the normal cooking menu? Check out Kaya's wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6305]CCS Kitchen Station Set[/url]﻿.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cVevYNe.png[/img]﻿

﻿See MouseyPounds database!
﻿
[url=https://mouseypounds.github.io/ppja-ref/index.html]L I N K[/url][url=https://mouseypounds.github.io/ppja-ref/index.html][/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]

- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI﻿ [/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url] (optional, to get seeds in the mail)
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (optional, for legacy sprites)
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598/?]Fruits and Veggies[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671/?]More Trees
[/url]- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028]Mizu's Flowers[/url]﻿
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿

If you are bothered by `Not sure what Tapioca` it is for the `Bubble Tea` which you'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]Artisan Valley[/url]﻿ for.
[u]Your game will still run 100% fine with this error.[/u] If you don't want everything Artisan Valley offers.

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]﻿

Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, Fruits and Veggies, More Trees, SpaceCore, Mizu's Flowers, and Mail Framework Mod (optional).
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 2 files included in the download:

[JA] More Recipes (Fruits and Veggies)
[MFM] More Recipes (optional)

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿

Step 1. Remove every existing item (crop, clothing, seeds, etc.) excluding items in shops & letters.
Step 2. Remove the corresponding folders.

Forgetting to remove existing items (especially in your inventory) can crash your game.

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/MRDrwER.png[/img]﻿

Please make sure to follow the steps/general troubleshooting found [url=https://github.com/paradigmnomad/PPJA/wiki/Troubleshooting]here[/url] before posting your log. 90% of errors users report can be solved by following those steps.
If you're still having issues, attach your [url=https://log.smapi.io/]SMAPI log[/url] or reach out to the community in the [url=https://stardewvalley.community/]Stardew Valley Discord[/url].[/left]
